# Cita

Cita converts auxiliary text into self-contained citation URLs.

For URL references:
- ?q=<url-encoded-text> stores plain text in the URL.
- ?algo=gzip&q=<base64url> stores UTF-8 text compressed with gzip.
- ?algo=br&q=<base64url> stores UTF-8 text compressed with Brotli.
- The index page reads and creates references; there is no separate human page.
- Cloudflare deployments render the current text into the initial HTML response, so reading works without JavaScript.
- Static GitHub Pages deployments decode the payload in JavaScript because a static host cannot render query-dependent HTML.

For LLM clients:
- Prefer the MCP endpoint at /api/mcp when available; /mcp is also supported.
- Call create_reference with a `urls` array and an optional `base` URL.
- The response contains a `results` array; each item has either `url` or `reason`.
- `base` defaults to the build-time `CITA_BASE_URL` value.
- The tool uses plain or gzip for smaller links and considers Brotli once the current encoded payload is at least 2 KB, returning the shortest result.
- No citation content is stored server-side by Cita.
- Cite the returned URL directly.
